title: [ingest] SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH copyright substitution only affects the current system-clock year
summary: `correct_copyright_year()` compares `current_year` (local time) against `source_date_epoch_year` and does nothing if `current_year <= source_date_epoch_year`. This means future-dated copyright entries are never updated, but past-year SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH values correctly back-substitute the copyright year.
